_comment: Websites for orgs that orgs-seed.json does not cover, keyed by org slug. `bun run find-org-links` adds candidates with where they came from (via); `bun run seed` writes them to orgs.website and clears the website of any org in neither file. Fix a wrong url in place; set url to null to reject a candidate so it stays off the site and is not proposed again. `bun run fetch-logos` turns websites into public/logos/<slug>.png.
